title: UKG
subtitle: Upper Kindergarten / KG2

delivery_legend.digital: Fully teachable on screen. The engine serves these.
delivery_legend.parent_guided: Physical-world learning. The app shows the parent an activity card and records completion — it does NOT fake a tap question for it.
delivery_legend.hybrid: Screen introduces it, a physical action completes it.

topics.title: Pre-Maths Concepts
topics.objective: Big/small, front/back, full/empty, heavy/light, in/out, more/less, right/left, same/different, tall/short, thick/thin, top/bottom
topics.intro_message: Let us compare things in every way we can!

activities.prompt: Which book is THICK?
Who is standing at the BACK of the line?
activities.hint: The back is the end of the line.

activities.prompt: 6 mangoes and 9 mangoes. Which is LESS?
Which side is the boy's RIGHT hand?
activities.hint: Face the same way he is facing.

activities.prompt: Which bottle is HALF full?
activities.hint: Half means part of the way up.

activities.prompt: Which shape is DIFFERENT from the rest?

topics.title: Numbers (1-200)
topics.objective: Counting forward and backward, before/after/between, number names, skip counting
topics.intro_message: Big numbers now! Let us count far and wide.

activities.prompt: What comes BETWEEN 24 and 26?
What comes AFTER 39?
Count backwards: 15, 14, 13, ?
How do we write the number 'twelve'?
What is the name of the number 30?
Skip count by 2: 2, 4, 6, ?
Skip count by 5: 5, 10, 15, ?
Write the number 15.

topics.title: Addition & Subtraction
topics.objective: Picture and 1-digit addition and subtraction; comparison signs
topics.intro_message: Let us put numbers together and take them apart!

activities.prompt: 2 apples and 3 apples. How many altogether?
There were 5 balloons. 2 flew away. How many are left?
activities.hint: Take two away and count what remains.
Start at four and count on three.
Count backwards four steps from nine.

activities.prompt: Which sign goes here? 8 __ 5
activities.hint: The open mouth eats the bigger number.

activities.prompt: Which sign goes here? 3 __ 6
Which sign goes here? 4 __ 4

topics.title: Shapes
topics.objective: Circle, oval, semi-circle, diamond, square, rectangle, triangle
topics.intro_message: More shapes to discover!

activities.prompt: Tap the oval.
activities.hint: Like a squashed circle, or an egg.

activities.prompt: Tap the diamond.
activities.hint: A square standing on its corner.

activities.prompt: Tap the semi-circle.
How many corners does a rectangle have?
Which object is shaped like an oval?

topics.title: Colours & Shades
topics.objective: Nine colours and their light and dark shades
topics.intro_message: Every colour has a light side and a dark side!

activities.prompt: Tap the purple one.
Which one is LIGHT blue?
Which one is DARK green?
Red and yellow mixed together make which colour?

topics.title: Money & Time
topics.objective: Coins and notes; o'clock, day and night, days of the week
topics.intro_message: Let us learn about money and telling the time!

activities.prompt: Which coin is worth MORE?
Two 2-rupee coins. How many rupees altogether?
The big hand is on 12 and the small hand is on 3. What time is it?
activities.hint: The small hand tells the hour.

activities.prompt: When do we see the moon and stars?
Which day comes after Monday?
How many days are there in a week?

topics.title: Letters (Aa-Zz)
topics.objective: Revise all letters, sounds, vowels and consonants
topics.intro_message: You know your letters. Let us make them strong!
topics.generation_rule: For each letter a-z emit a sound-recall and a beginning-sound question. 26 x 2 = 52 activities.

activities.prompt: How many vowels are there in English?
Which of these is a CONSONANT?
activities.hint: Anything that is not a vowel.

activities.prompt: Which word begins with the same sound as ZEBRA?
Which word ends with the sound 't'?
activities.hint: Say each word and listen to the end.

topics.title: Early Grammar
topics.objective: Articles, one-many, positions, this/that, these/those, in/on/under
topics.intro_message: Small words help us say exactly what we mean.

activities.prompt: Choose the right word: ___ umbrella
The cat is ___ the table.
The book is ___ the bag.
The cup is ___ the table.
One child, many ___?
activities.hint: This one is special — it does not take an 's'.

activities.prompt: The flowers are here beside me. THESE or THOSE flowers?

topics.title: Words & Rhyming
topics.objective: Vowel words and rhyming families
topics.intro_message: Words that sound alike are friends!

activities.prompt: Fill the gap: b _ t (something you hit a ball with)
Fill the gap: h _ n (a bird that lays eggs)
Fill the gap: p _ t (we cook in it)
Which of these does NOT rhyme with CAT?
activities.hint: Cat, mat and rat all end in -at.

activities.prompt: Which word rhymes with PIG?

topics.title: Reading & Conversation
topics.objective: Read simple words and sentences, picture composition, social conversation
topics.intro_message: You are ready to read! Let us try.

activities.prompt: Read this word and tap the matching picture: SUN
Read: 'The dog is big.' Which picture matches?
Put these words in order: 'ball' 'the' 'red' 'is'
Someone asks 'How are you?' What do you say?
activities.hint: Say: I am fine, thank you.

activities.prompt: Look at a picture and say four sentences about it.
activities.hint: Who is there? What are they doing?
activities.parent_note: Ask open questions rather than correcting grammar. Fluency first, accuracy later.

topics.title: Activities
topics.objective: Flashcards, storytelling, enactment and worksheets — English through play
topics.intro_message: Let us play with words: a story, some cards, and a little acting!

activities.prompt: Today we play with words — cards, a story, and some acting!
activities.hint: No writing yet. Just look and listen.

activities.prompt: Here is a little story: a cat sat on a mat and a rat ran past!
activities.hint: Listen for the words that sound the same.

activities.prompt: In the story, where did the cat sit?
activities.hint: The cat sat on the mat.

activities.prompt: Flashcard time! Which card starts the word 'ball'?
activities.hint: Ball begins with a buh sound.

activities.prompt: Your turn to act it out. Say: 'The cat sat on the mat.'
activities.correct_answer: the cat sat on the mat
accept: the cat sat on a mat
activities.hint: Say it slowly, one word at a time.

activities.prompt: Together time: act out the story with a grown-up.
activities.hint: One of you is the cat, one is the rat!
activities.parent_note: Take turns being the cat and the rat, then ask your child to tell the story back in their own words.

topics.title: Myself
topics.objective: Body parts, sense organs, home, family, school, seasons
topics.intro_message: Let us learn how your body works!

activities.prompt: Which sense organ helps us taste?
Which sense organ helps us touch and feel?
How many sense organs do we have?
In which season do farmers wait for rain?
A family with parents, children, grandparents and uncles is called a ___ family.

topics.title: Transport
topics.objective: Land, water and air transport
topics.intro_message: How many ways can we travel? Let us count!

activities.prompt: Which of these is LAND transport?
Which of these is WATER transport?
Which vehicle takes sick people to hospital quickly?
Which vehicle puts out fires?
activities.hint: It is red and carries water.

topics.title: Animals
topics.objective: Wild, domestic, pet, farm and water animals; sounds and young ones
topics.intro_message: Let us learn about animal families!

activities.prompt: What is a baby dog called?
What is a baby cat called?
What is a baby cow called?
Which animal roars?
Which animal do we find on a FARM?
Which animal gives us wool?
activities.hint: Its coat is soft and fluffy.

topics.title: Air, Water & Sound Pollution
topics.objective: Introduction to the three kinds of pollution
topics.intro_message: Our world needs our care. Let us learn how to protect it.

activities.prompt: What makes the air dirty?
activities.hint: It comes from vehicles and factories.

activities.prompt: Should we throw rubbish into a river?
activities.hint: It makes the water dirty for everyone.

activities.prompt: Too much loud noise is called ___ pollution.
What can we plant to make the air cleaner?

topics.title: Our Community
topics.objective: Visit a police station or post office; observe types of transport
topics.intro_message: Let us explore the world outside!
topics.note: A screen cannot replace a visit. These are parent activity cards; the app records completion and celebrates, but asks no tap questions.

activities.prompt: Visit a post office with a grown-up and see how letters travel.
activities.hint: Look for the letter box and the stamps.
activities.parent_note: Let the child post a letter themselves. Ask what they think happens next.

activities.prompt: Stand safely by a road and count five different vehicles.
activities.hint: Name each one as it passes.
activities.parent_note: Stay well back from the kerb. Turn it into a tally game.

activities.prompt: Collect five living and five non-living things and sort them.
activities.hint: Ask: does it grow? does it need food?
activities.parent_note: Ask the child to justify each choice. The reasoning is the learning.

subjects.title: Language (Hindi)

topics.title: स्वर (अ - अः)
topics.objective: Identify and sound the Hindi vowels
topics.intro_message: आओ, स्वर सीखें!

activities.prompt: यह 'अ' है। अ से अनार।
'अ' पर टैप करो।
'आ' पर टैप करो।
'इ' से क्या बनता है?

topics.title: व्यंजन (क - ज्ञ)
topics.objective: Identify the Hindi consonants and related words
topics.intro_message: अब व्यंजन सीखते हैं!

activities.prompt: यह 'क' है। क से कमल।
'क' पर टैप करो।
'ग' से क्या बनता है?

topics.title: मात्राओं का ज्ञान
topics.objective: Apply अ and आ matras to consonants
topics.intro_message: मात्रा लगाने से नए शब्द बनते हैं!

activities.prompt: क + आ = ?
activities.hint: आ की मात्रा एक खड़ी लकीर है।

activities.prompt: म + आ = ?
'ना' और 'क' मिलकर क्या बनाते हैं?

subjects.note: Retained as published. Removal was requested for Nursery and Play Group only, and both have since been restored.

subjects.title: Rhymes

topics.title: Counting Rhymes
topics.objective: Count along to three rhymes, forwards and backwards
topics.intro_message: Let us count while we sing!

activities.prompt: Let us sing 'Rabbits, Rabbits, 1, 2, 3'!
In the rhyme, which animal has a hump?
Let us sing 'The Peapod'!
activities.hint: Five little peas in a peapod pressed.

activities.prompt: How many little peas were in the peapod?
activities.hint: Five little peas, in a peapod pressed.

activities.prompt: Let us sing the 'Indian Song' — up to ten and back!
activities.hint: One little, two little, three little...

activities.prompt: In the 'Indian Song', we count up to ten. Then what happens?
activities.hint: Ten little, nine little, eight little...

topics.title: Rhymes About Me
topics.objective: Point to each body part while singing
topics.intro_message: Sing along and point to yourself!

activities.prompt: Let us sing 'All About Me' and point to each part!
In 'All About Me', what do we see with?
activities.hint: These are eyes, with which I see.

activities.prompt: Let us sing 'Little Me' and wiggle along!
activities.hint: Ten little toes all in a row.

activities.prompt: In 'Little Me', how many little toes are in a row?
activities.hint: Ten little toes all in a row.

topics.title: Nature Rhymes
topics.objective: Sing about the sun, seeds and growing things
topics.intro_message: Let us sing about the world outside!

activities.prompt: Let us sing 'The Cherry Tree'!
activities.hint: A tiny stone grows into a tree.

activities.prompt: In 'The Cherry Tree', what was planted in the ground?
Let us sing 'This Is the Sun'!
activities.hint: The sun is big and round.

activities.prompt: In 'This Is the Sun', where do the yachts sail?
activities.hint: These are the yachts that sail on the seas.

activities.prompt: Let us sing 'Thank You God'!
activities.hint: Thank you for the birds that sing.

activities.prompt: In 'Thank You God', what do the birds do?
activities.hint: Thank you, God, for the birds that sing.

topics.title: Colour & Fun Rhymes
topics.objective: Sing about colours, balloons and a very funny clown
topics.intro_message: Time for the happiest songs!

activities.prompt: Let us sing 'Colours of the Rainbow'!
How many colours are in a rainbow?
Let us sing 'My Balloon'!
activities.hint: A red or a blue, or a yellow will do.

activities.prompt: In 'My Balloon', what did we go to the shop to buy?
activities.hint: To buy a balloon that won't go pop.

activities.prompt: Let us sing 'The Clown'! Ha, ha, hee, hee!
activities.hint: He laughs and laughs all day.

activities.prompt: In the rhyme, what does the clown do all day?
activities.hint: He laughs and laughs all day.

subjects.note: One rhyme_listen per rhyme and one recall question about it, kept together in the same level so the question always follows the singing.

decisions: Language (Hindi) is retained as published. It was removed once and restored on request, so the manifest no longer lists it under removed_subject_ids and this content is served.
Rhymes is delivered as a sixth subject. The syllabus publishes its eleven rhymes alongside the five subjects rather than inside one.
